metadata.source: CHARTA — Red Internacional CHARTA (Corpus Hispánico y Americano en la Red: Textos Antiguos)
metadata.citation: Red Internacional CHARTA. Corpus CHARTA en TEITOK. Universidad de Alcalá / GITHE.
metadata.description: Vocabulary extracted from 787 TEI XML documents (787 attempted, 0 errors) in the CHARTA corpus. Layers included: paleographic, expanded, normalized. Documents span historical Spanish texts from the Iberian Peninsula and Latin America (legislative, judicial, commercial, private).
